summary: You choose the Molecular, Cellular and Translational track or the Computational and Systems track. The audit checks the 135 graduate units, research included, the core courses, one statistics course, the track's courses and electives, and nine quarters of IMMUNOL 305, with required and elective courses letter graded where a letter grade is offered and every letter grade B- or better. Checked by hand: the seminar series, Startup, retreat, SIP talks, three lab rotations, the two-part qualifying exam, committee meetings and IDP, ten units a quarter until TGR, two teaching assistantships, the dissertation and the defense.

program.why: Grading: "Students must earn a grade of B- or better in all courses applicable to the degree that are taken for a letter grade."

LErjbkOr.why: "Students are required to register for at least 9 quarters of Immunol 305." Nine registrations of the repeatable course; the core's IMMUNOL 305 is one of them. Grading: "Required and elective courses must be taken for a letter grade, unless a letter grade is not an option when registering for the class." Set on the course rules rather than program-wide, so research units taken for credit still count toward the 135.

node.name: At least three lab rotations of six weeks or more

add.why: "First year Immunology students are required to do at least 3 rotations ... Each of the 3 rotations must be at least 6 weeks in duration ... At least two of these rotations should be in Immunology labs."

node.name: Qualifying Examination, Parts I and II

add.why: "first-year immunology graduate students are required to give a presentation on one of their three rotations ... (Qualifying Examination Process, Part I)" and "The student is required to pass the oral examination and write a thesis dissertation proposal" (Part II).

node.name: Thesis committee meetings and annual Individual Development Plan

add.why: "In the first through third years, the student must meet with the Ph.D. thesis committee at least once a year. In the fourth and fifth years ... twice a year" and "Graduate students are required to meet with their faculty mentors once a year to discuss an individual development plan (IDP)."

node.name: Enrolled in exactly ten units each quarter until TGR

add.why: "All students must be enrolled in exactly ten units during autumn, winter, spring, and summer quarters until reaching Terminal Graduate Residence (TGR) status"

node.name: Two teaching assistantships (one List A, one List B; MSTP one List A)

add.why: "Each student assists in teaching two courses in the immunology core or electives; one from List A and one from list B. MSTP students are only required to do one List A TAship."

node.name: Petition to Defend and oral examination

add.why: "Before embarking on the dissertation defense process, the graduate student must submit a Petition to Defend ... A substantial draft of the dissertation must be turned in to the student's Oral Committee at least one month before the oral exam"
